entities.name: Caztaca Huicintli
entities.description: Apex priestess of the Threefold Sun in the Sun Empire, eldest daughter of Apatzec Intli III and chief tutor of her boy-emperor brother.

entities.name: Apatzec Intli III
entities.description: Caztaca's father, emperor who named his son successor.

entities.name: Atlacan Huicintli
entities.description: Caztaca's bellicose brother whom she plotted to depose.

entities.name: Threefold Sun
entities.description: Religion whose priests Caztaca was close to.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: Empire on Ixalan of which Caztaca is a priestess.

entities.name: Otepec
entities.description: Place Caztaca held dominion over before its destruction.

entities.name: Saint Elenda of Garrano
entities.description: Conspired with Caztaca to subvert Vona de Iedo's faction.

entities.name: Vona de Iedo
entities.description: The Antifex, leader of a rising faction.

entities.name: Beckett Brass
entities.description: Admiral who agreed to support the two factions in exchange for a Brazen Coalition state.

events.summary: Intli III names his newborn son Intli IV successor instead of Caztaca.
events.quote: Intli III named him successor instead of Caztaca

events.summary: After the invasion Caztaca plots to depose her bellicose brother Atlacan and conspires with Saint Elenda of Garrano.
events.quote: Caztaca plotted to depose her bellicose brother Atlacan

events.summary: Admiral Beckett Brass crashes a meeting of the two factions and agrees to support their causes in exchange for a Brazen Coalition state.
events.quote: Admiral Beckett Brass crashed a meeting of the two factions
